title: Greet Experience
text: We were met promptly by Clara who took us on a walking tour through the market.  It was interesting and we were able to ask questions and get additional insight.  We then went to the kitchen and was greeted by Maria.  Both Clara and Maria were a delight.  There was 14 of us, with a mix of cooking abilities.  They incorporated all of us into the cooking preparations and we shared many laughs and ate terrific food.  We were given access to the recipes and look forward to trying to replicate the delightful meal that we had thanks to Maria and Clara's tutelage.  I definitely recommend this to anyo
author: 923LindaJ
